name: Tình Khúc Bạch Dương
overview: The story followed the romance between two pairs, Hùng and Quyên, and Quang and Vân. They spent beautiful days of youth together. But the hardships of being away from their home country, their egos and selfishness pushed each other away. 30 years later, all four still have to deal with the wounds from their past in undesirable ways.
